create_quantlinear_layer: create a QuantLinear layer with Exl2Weight or GPTQWeight for 4-bit quantized inference
run_gemm_half_q_half: run matrix multiplication of input tensor x with quantized q4 weights using ext_gemm_half_q_half
build_q_matrix: build a Q matrix handle from Exl2Weight or GPTQWeight using ext_make_q_matrix for inference
create_exllama_buffers: create exllama scratch space buffers and initialize all registered QuantLinear layers with temp_dq
make_group_map: make a group mapping tensor from q_groups and num_qrows for EXL2 quantized weights
